Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Replaced the single Gear section focus dropdown with checkboxes for all 11 gear sections. Multiple sections can now be included in one run, making it easier to omit only the armoury tabs that are already full. Existing focus settings migrate automatically.
